item.description:
Release 0.2.4.
- Sign in works on a fresh Mac. No ~/.tradeautopsy/station.env file. Station uses https://www.tradeautopsy.in and the public WorkOS client. - Journal capture status waits briefly for the local agent instead of failing on the first paint.
**Unsigned build:** After download, drag to Applications, then **right-click → Open → Open** (or System Settings → Open Anyway). Quarantine applies to Sparkle updates too until we ship notarized builds.
